Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Kant Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anoop Kumar Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Personal affidavit of Shri Om Kumar, Superintendent of Police, Basti filed by the learned A.G.A. is taken in the record.

By means of the bail application, the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.0164 of 2022 at Police Station-Walter Ganj, District-Basti under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
504, 506, 120-B IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 22.11.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 12.12.2022.

The following arguments made by Shri Rahul Kumar Sharma, learned counsel and Shri Chandra Kant Tripathi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Munne Lal, learned A.G.A. for the State from the record and Shri Anoop Kumar, learned counsel for the informant, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:

sentences.text: (1). The applicant is a victim and not a perpetrator of the fraud.
(2). The applicant was induced into parting with his money by the principal offenders with the promise of a job.
(3). The informant deposited the entire amount in the account of "K.Balaji".
(4). The money was not credited to the bank account of the applicant.
(5). The applicant is not a beneficiary of any illicit transaction.
(6). The applicant and the informant had made a joint complaint to the Superintendent of Police, Basti regarding fraud committed on them by the principal offenders.
(7). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(8). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
(9). The applicant-Manoj Chaudhary undertakes to withdraw the criminal case against Vikas son of the informant.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Manoj Chaudhary be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Manoj Chaudhary vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47033301/
